name: Mycelium Stepped Bubbles
description: Deterministic stepped pitch/filter motion makes burbling alien sequences from held notes. Two unsynchronized LFOs produce the step pattern; repeatable, not random. MIDI 36–76. Built-in filtered echoes and reverb; no global FX needed. Velocity-sensitive, polyphonic, three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.
